profile.missing.title: Create your profile
profile.missing.content: A profile is required before predictions, school planning, essays, and timelines can become personalized.

profile.gpa_anchor.title: Complete your GPA anchor
profile.gpa_anchor.content: Add GPA and scale so predictions and school-list advice use your real academic baseline.

profile.major.title: Add your intended major
profile.major.content: Your major helps recommendations and application analysis compare the right programs.

profile.test_strategy.title: Set your test strategy
profile.test_strategy.content: Tell us whether you have scores, plan to test, or are applying test-optional.

profile.activities.title: Add activities
profile.activities.content: Activities make profile analysis and school fit less generic.

profile.awards.title: Add awards
profile.awards.content: Awards help the platform understand academic and extracurricular distinction.

profile.basic_context.title: Complete basic school context
profile.basic_context.content: Grade, curriculum, and school context help compare your profile fairly.

profile.demographics.title: Review applicant context
profile.demographics.content: Applicant context keeps recommendation and timeline guidance aligned with your situation.

profile.education.title: Add education history
profile.education.content: Education history helps interpret GPA, curriculum, and school context.

school_list.add_first.title: Add your first target school
school_list.add_first.content: A school list unlocks school-specific readiness, deadlines, predictions, and essays.

school_list.min_count.title: Expand your school list
school_list.min_count.content: A broader list makes reach, target, and safety planning more useful.

school_list.balance.title: Balance your school list
school_list.balance.content: A balanced list helps reduce strategy risk across reach, target, and safety schools.

timeline.missing_school_round.title: Set application rounds
timeline.missing_school_round.content: Application rounds let the platform generate the right deadline tasks for each school.

timeline.overdue_tasks.title: Review overdue timeline tasks
timeline.overdue_tasks.content: Overdue tasks can hide execution risk even when your school list is ready.

essays.none.title: Start your essay workspace
essays.none.content: Essay drafts connect your profile to prompt-specific guidance and deadlines.

essays.prompt_link_missing.title: Link essays to prompts
essays.prompt_link_missing.content: Prompt links keep essay work connected to each school's current requirements.

recommendation_letters.min_submitted.title: Track recommendation letters
recommendation_letters.min_submitted.content: Recommendation status helps application readiness reflect what is still outstanding.

resume.none.title: Create a resume artifact
resume.none.content: A resume gives essay, activity, and application analysis more reliable context.
